label: Forensic Sampling & Transport Kit
description: Standardized kit for collecting and shipping microscopic powder samples to external analytical laboratories.

components.function: Used to extract 10-20mg of enamel powder from a tooth.
Leak-proof containers for the extracted powder.
Ensures the 'outsource' lab knows exactly which specimen the powder came from.

game_mechanics.shipping_delay: Once sent, the player loses access to that sample for 72 hours, creating a 'waiting' period that encourages them to work on other fossils.
game_mechanics.contamination_risk: If the player doesn't wear gloves during sampling, the report might come back as 'Inconclusive: Human Contamination Found.'
